scripts.hash-password: ts-node -e "import { createInterface, Interface } from 'node:readline'; import { hash } from 'bcrypt'; const input: Interface = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout }); input.question('Password (visible; local terminal only): ', (password: string): void => { input.close(); if (password.length < 12 || Buffer.byteLength(password, 'utf8') > 72) { console.error('Use 12+ characters, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes'); process.exitCode = 1; return; } void hash(password, 12).then((value: string): void => { console.log(value); }); });"
